title: Cyclic toric ideal generators not made explicit; 'any Markov basis' is not closed form (Thm 3.3(d), Ex 4.2)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Thm 3.3(d) correctly identifies the cyclic part $I^\circ$ as a lattice ideal, but the generators are only 'any Markov basis of $L=\ker(\mathbb Z^p\to\mathbb Z^n)$' — non-canonical, not given as an explicit function of the weight data $w_i$. Example 4.2 states 'an explicit computation returns 69 binomial generators' without listing them or proving the count; only 5 sample binomials are shown (these I verified hold: e.g. $U_1^2U_2-U_3U_4=0$ etc., and the 14-element Hilbert basis claim is correct). But 5 of 69 is not a generating set and generation is not proved. An explicit per-stratum answer requires a canonical/closed-form generating set of $L$ derived from $w$, with a proof of generation.
